author: Yffe
content: Discovered during #17. §9 composition rule: a pure-Thermite caller of a #[boundary] (or #[slag]) fn should VERIFY through the callee's CONTRACT (g's cert valid independent of f's body). Currently a boundary-caller fails at L0: forge's L3 lowering does not emit the boundary fn as a verus-assumable signature, so verus sees an undefined callee. To make 'verified to the boundary' an achievable STATUS (not just a syntactic label on a failed cert), thermite-lower must emit each boundary/slag fn referenced by a caller as a verus assume-spec signature (req->requires, ens->ensures, no body / external_body) in the caller's sub-program. Demonstrated: caller calling ext_id -> L0 (scope correctly to_boundary via ext_id, but unverified). #17 ships the CLASSIFICATION (correct + orthogonal to level per the oracle); this composition lowering is the separate piece that lets the caller actually reach verified-to-the-boundary.
